summary: Financial creditor classification under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016; interpretation of Deeds of Hypothecation (DoH); pooling arrangement among RCom entities; three-fold obligations under DoH including shortfall guarantee; distinction between security and guarantee; NCLAT error in treating DoH as non-guarantee document; admission as financial creditors required under IBC s.5(7); resolution plan approval context; contract interpretation principles.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; NCLAT judgment set aside; appellants recognized as financial creditors; matter remanded to NCLT for consequential actions.
